card.name: Blood count test and sample-tube wording
card.fires_on: Words inside text about blood counts and blood sample tubes, such as the opening bracket or 'in' or 'containing' after 'platelet counts' or 'collected', and 'platelet' or 'WBC'. It is strongest in the ADAKVEO platelet-clumping test interference passage.

modes.label: Platelet count interference
modes.description: Words in or just after the phrase automated platelet counts (platelet clumping).
modes.example: Test Interference Interference with automated platelet counts<< (>>platelet clumping) has been observed

modes.label: Sample collection tubes
modes.description: Small words linking blood collection to tube type, such as EDTA or citrate tubes.

modes.label: Other lab blood tests
modes.description: Words in other lab-procedure or blood-measure text, such as WBC tubes or hematocrit meters.

card.writes: It leans toward blood-count terms such as CBC and blood, and away from 'macro' words.
card.plain: It fires on wording about blood counts and the tubes blood is drawn into for lab tests.
